requests.exactPromptSuffix: LOCOMOTION atlas. Columns are an eight-frame seamless WALK cycle: contact, down, passing, up, contact, down, passing, up. Cloak and sash lag with bold readable arcs, lyre firmly strapped across his back, feet never slide. Each row shows the identical cycle from its specified facing.

RUN atlas. Columns are an eight-frame seamless fast RUN cycle with strong forward lean, airborne phases and long ragged cloak/sash drag. Lyre remains secure; readable enemy-scale silhouette. Each row is the identical run cycle from its specified facing.

DASH AND STAIRS atlas. Columns form eight ordered key poses usable across dash start, compressed dash travel, dash strike, dash settle, stair ascent and stair descent: brace, launch, low smear pose, extended travel, lyre-assisted strike, recoil, high stair step, low descending step. Very readable silhouette with broad oil streaks. Each row shows those exact phases from its specified facing.

SOFT LYRE COMBAT atlas. Eight ordered columns form a fluid combo sequence: draw lyre forward, ready, low chord slash, recoil, reverse chord slash, recoil, overhead third chord strike, luminous soft-bolt release. Golden lyre is the weapon, not a sword. Bold broad oil arcs, powerful readable enemy-scale silhouette. Every row shows the same sequence from its specified facing.

HARD CADENCE COMBAT atlas. Eight columns: grounded hard-boom windup, deeper windup, explosive lyre chord release, Hymn of Dawn forward beam pose, Sanctuary protective cast, Sirens convergence vortex pull, full-voice release, phrase resolve. Body-only transparent poses with restrained golden-white musical paint accents attached to hands/lyre; no floor or background. Every row shows the same sequence from its specified facing.

LYRE SINGING atlas. Eight columns make a musical performance cycle: lyre draw, poised soft pluck, pluck follow-through, inhale, singing sustain open chest, singing sustain lifted head, full voice crescendo, gentle phrase resolve. Expressive but combat-ready, face readable, broad oil strokes, golden lyre held correctly. Every row shows the same sequence from its specified facing.
